derivations.method: Report 20:20 is printed, but the station is not printed; the duty starts at ORD (crew nightstopped there from 01/09), so 20:20 was converted as ORD local = 2026-09-04T01:20Z. Confirmed by the printed block 9h00 matching 21:50 ORD → 13:50 MAD.
Printed report 21:40 converted as JFK local (duty starts at the JFK nightstop) = 2026-09-08T01:40Z; block 8h00 for 23:10 JFK → 13:10 MAD confirms the JFK reading.
Off Duty 06:18 carries no date; the last two sectors run past midnight, so it is 06:18 MAD local on 12/09 = 2026-09-12T04:18Z. Confirmed by the printed duty length 14h53 from report 13:25Z.
Off Duty 00:14 is after the 23:44 arrival, so it falls on 25/09 MAD local = 2026-09-24T22:14Z; printed duty 11h54 from report 10:20Z confirms.
STA 08:10 and Off Duty 08:40 are SIN local on the following day (block 13h30 from 12:40 MAD = 10:40Z gives 00:10Z on 27/09 = 08:10 SIN); printed duty 15h30 from report 09:10Z confirms.
Printed report 11:10 converted as SIN local (duty starts at the SIN nightstop) = 2026-09-28T03:10Z; block 13h30 from 12:40 SIN to 20:10 MAD confirms.
